sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: On a Friday evening in the summer of 2011, Los Angeles resident Brent Green was driving home from work.
sentences.zh: 2011年夏天的一个周五傍晚，洛杉矶居民布伦特·格林正开车下班回家。

sentences.en: He was coming from a job site and took a route he doesn't usually take to get to his neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他当时刚从一个工作地点离开，并走了一条平时不常走的路回家。

sentences.en: And I might not have come this way.
sentences.zh: 我可能本来不会走这条路。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm glad I did.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我很高兴我走了。

sentences.en: Because when I saw this, I knew that it was a problem and I got out of my car.
sentences.zh: 因为当我看到这个时，我知道出问题了，于是我下了车。

sentences.en: What did you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: That's our producer Sam Greenspan.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的制片人萨姆·格林斯潘。

sentences.en: He met with Brent in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他在洛杉矶见到了布伦特。

sentences.en: I saw about 25 to 30 guys with heavy equipment, all wearing orange jumpsuits.
sentences.zh: 我看到大约25到30个人带着重型设备，全都穿着橙色连体工作服。

sentences.en: They had backhoes.
sentences.zh: 他们有反铲挖土机。

sentences.en: They had trencher, trenching machines.
sentences.zh: 他们有挖沟机。

sentences.en: I mean, like large tractor material.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就像大型拖拉机那样的设备。

sentences.en: Like stuff that you can't just, like, ignore.
sentences.zh: 就像那种你根本无法忽视的东西。

sentences.en: You and I might not think there's anything weird about a bunch of guys doing work on a freeway berm.
sentences.zh: 你和我可能觉得一帮人在高速公路边坡上干活没什么奇怪的。

sentences.en: But Brent took one look and thought, well, this all seems kind of fishy.
sentences.zh: 但布伦特看了一眼就想，嗯，这一切看起来有点可疑。

sentences.en: For starters, it seemed late for a city work crew to be doing landscaping.
sentences.zh: 首先，城市施工队在这个时间进行绿化作业似乎有点太晚了。

sentences.en: And I said, that's odd.
sentences.zh: 我说，这太奇怪了。

sentences.en: It's almost 7 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 快到7点了。

sentences.en: They're not even out here at 7 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 他们7点根本不在外面干活。

sentences.en: So what are they doing?
sentences.zh: 那他们在干什么？

sentences.en: They've got to be up to something.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定在搞什么名堂。

sentences.en: The crew was manicuring some trees in a fenced-off piece of land next to a freeway in what had long been a low-income neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 施工队在一个长期属于低收入社区的高速公路旁的一块围起来的土地上修剪树木。

sentences.en: It's a patch of land that never gets landscaped.
sentences.zh: 那是一块从来没有人进行过绿化的土地。

sentences.en: The only reason the trees were there was because about 40 years ago, some birds flew over and pooped out fertilized seeds.
sentences.zh: 这些树之所以存在，只是因为大约40年前，一些鸟飞过并排泄了带有养分的种子。

sentences.en: And no one ever touched them.
sentences.zh: 而且从来没有人管过它们。

sentences.en: It's not like they're just cleaning the tree up to make it look better on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 这不像是他们为了让高速公路看起来更好看而修整树木。

sentences.en: Look at all the rest of them.
sentences.zh: 看看剩下的那些。

sentences.en: They all look like crap.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来都像垃圾一样。

sentences.en: And that's when Brent put it together.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，布伦特把这些线索串联了起来。

sentences.en: A work crew doing an after-hours landscaping job in an area where they never do any work.
sentences.zh: 一个施工队在一个从不进行任何绿化作业的地区加班进行绿化工作。

sentences.en: To Brent, this meant one thing.
sentences.zh: 对布伦特来说，这意味着一件事。

sentences.en: I know with all my being that they're taking the trees illegally.
sentences.zh: 我全身心地确信他们在非法偷树。

sentences.en: Stealing trees.
sentences.zh: 偷树。

sentences.en: Now, the reason that Brent Green was able to deduce all of this is because he is, by trade, a landscape designer.
sentences.zh: 现在，布伦特·格林之所以能推断出这一切，是因为他的职业是景观设计师。

sentences.en: And so he knew the worth of the trees that the work crew had been messing with.
sentences.zh: 所以他知道这群工人一直在动那些树的价值。

sentences.en: I've actually purchased these trees for projects, and they're like 20 grand.
sentences.zh: 我实际上为项目买过这些树，它们大约值2万块。
每棵树2万美元。

sentences.en: Brent confronted the workers and asked them what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 布伦特质问工人们在做什么。

sentences.en: Some of them took off running.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人撒腿就跑。

sentences.en: Later, a woman who lives on that street came down from her apartment, and Brent asked her if she knew what was going on.
sentences.zh: 后来，住在那个街道上的一位女士从她的公寓走下来，布伦特问她是否知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: She said, honey, baby, they didn't just take that one.
sentences.zh: 她说，亲爱的，他们拿走的不仅仅是那一棵。

sentences.en: They took like six other ones.
sentences.zh: 他们还拿了大约其他六棵。

sentences.en: They took two over there, four over there.
sentences.zh: 那边拿了两棵，那边拿了四棵。

sentences.en: They've been here all week.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里待了整整一周。

sentences.en: I'm like, really?
sentences.zh: 我说，真的吗？

sentences.en: You know, then I called the police.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，然后我就报警了。

sentences.en: This is not the first case of palm theft.
sentences.zh: 这并不是第一起棕榈树盗窃案。

sentences.en: Palm rustling has been reported in Texas and San Diego.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州和圣迭戈都曾报道过盗伐棕榈树的事件。

sentences.en: It even gets a mention in Susan Orlean's book, The Orchid Thief.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·奥尔林的书中甚至提到了这一点，书名叫《兰花贼》。

sentences.en: And to understand why someone would want to steal a palm tree, we need to really understand their value,
sentences.zh: 为了理解为什么有人会想偷一棵棕榈树，我们真的需要了解它们的价值，

sentences.en: which has a lot to do with the space they occupy in our collective imagination.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上与它们在我们集体想象中所占据的空间有关。

sentences.en: And for that, we need to talk to this guy.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们需要和这个人聊聊。

sentences.en: My name is Jared Farmer.
sentences.zh: 我叫贾里德·法默。

sentences.en: I am the author of Trees in Paradise, a California history.
sentences.zh: 我是《天堂里的树：加利福尼亚历史》一书的作者。

sentences.en: In his book, Jared Farmer traces the history of the Golden State through four kinds of trees,
sentences.zh: 贾里德·法默在他的书中通过四种树追踪了金州的历史，

sentences.en: one of them being the palm.
sentences.zh: 其中一种就是棕榈树。

sentences.en: The others are the redwood, the citrus, and the eucalypt.
sentences.zh: 其他三种是红杉、柑橘和桉树。

sentences.en: Though we should get this out of the way first, a palm tree isn't really a tree.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们应该先把这一点搞清楚，棕榈树其实并不是一棵树。

sentences.en: It's actually not a tree.
sentences.zh: 它实际上不是一棵树。

sentences.en: It's kind of like grass.
sentences.zh: 它有点像草。

sentences.en: It's like a super grass.
sentences.zh: 它就像超级草。

sentences.en: It's like hundreds or thousands of these long blades of grass, in a sense, like fused together.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，它就像成百上千根融合在一起的长长的草叶。

sentences.en: Palm trees don't make bark or branches.
sentences.zh: 棕榈树不长树皮或树枝。

sentences.en: If you cut them down, you won't find any rings in the trunk.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它砍倒，你在树干里找不到任何年轮。

sentences.en: All their roots grow in a compact root ball, making them easier to steal than, say, like an oak tree,
sentences.zh: 它们所有的根都生长在一个紧凑的根球中，这使得它们比方说像橡树更容易被偷，

sentences.en: which has an expansive underground root network.
sentences.zh: 橡树拥有庞大的地下根系。

sentences.en: And as far as trees go, we don't plant palms for any of the normal reasons we want other trees around.
sentences.zh: 就树木而言，我们种植棕榈树并不是出于我们想要其他树木的那些正常原因。

sentences.en: It's not for the shade.
sentences.zh: 不是为了遮阴。

sentences.en: It's not for climbing.
sentences.zh: 不是为了爬树。

sentences.en: I mean, you can't really climb a palm tree very well.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你其实没办法很好地爬棕榈树。

sentences.en: They cast precious little shade.
sentences.zh: 它们投下的阴影少得可怜。

sentences.en: Palm trees, it seems, do something else.
sentences.zh: 看起来，棕榈树有别的用途。

sentences.en: They're evocative.
sentences.zh: 它们能唤起人们的情感。

sentences.en: They're transportative.
sentences.zh: 它们能带人去到别处。

sentences.en: They inspire us to dream big.
sentences.zh: 它们激励我们心怀大志。

sentences.en: It's about image and beauty and fashion and design and sometimes about architecture.
sentences.zh: 这关乎形象、美感、时尚、设计，有时还关乎建筑。

sentences.en: Palms, especially urban palms in places like Los Angeles, are planted less for what they do than what they mean,
sentences.zh: 棕榈树，尤其是像洛杉矶这样的地方的城市棕榈树，人们种植它们更多不是因为它们的实际作用，而是因为它们的象征意义，

sentences.en: or rather what they mean is what they do.
sentences.zh: 或者说，它们的象征意义就是它们的实际作用。

sentences.en: If you trace the history of what palm trees have symbolized in the Western imagination, as Jared Farmer has,
sentences.zh: 如果你像贾里德·法默那样，追溯西方人想象中棕榈树象征意义的历史，

sentences.en: you start to get the idea that palm trees have always been about evoking a spirit of elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 你就会开始明白，棕榈树一直以来都是为了唤起一种异国情调的精神。

sentences.en: Even 200 years ago, palm trees were planted in California by the Spanish as a way of signifying on the Holy Land.
sentences.zh: 甚至在200年前，西班牙人就在加利福尼亚种植棕榈树，作为象征圣地的一种方式。

sentences.en: Orthodox Christianity and Roman Catholicism often demands actually having fronds,
sentences.zh: 正统基督教和罗马天主教通常确实需要棕榈叶，

sentences.en: and that's the original reason the Spanish in California grew palm trees, is to have palms for Palm Sunday.
sentences.zh: 这也是西班牙人在加州种植棕榈树的最初原因，为了在棕榈主日时有棕榈叶可以用。

sentences.en: So palm trees were around by the time that California became a state in 1850.
sentences.zh: 所以早在1850年加利福尼亚成为一个州时，棕榈树就已经存在了。

sentences.en: And around that same time, there was a trend in art and literature of what we now call Orientalism,
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时期，艺术和文学界出现了一种我们现在称之为“东方主义”的潮流，

sentences.en: a kind of fascination with the EaSt.
sentences.zh: 一种对东方世界的迷恋。

sentences.en: Sort of that fantasy of like Arabs and Bedouins and Oasis and Scheherazade, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 有点像对阿拉伯人、贝都因人、绿洲和舍赫拉萨德的幻想，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And so palm trees dovetailed quite nicely with those kinds of fascinations.
sentences.zh: 因此，棕榈树与这种迷恋非常契合。

sentences.en: Palm trees were also used to make people think of the tropics.
sentences.zh: 棕榈树也被用来让人联想到热带地区。

sentences.en: And while these three tropes are unfolding, palm trees symbolizing the Holy Land, the Orient, the tropics,
sentences.zh: 正当这三种隐喻展开时——棕榈树象征着圣地、东方、热带，

sentences.en: they also kind of do this thing where they all congeal and collapse into a bigger notion that we can still recognize today.
sentences.zh: 它们也在某种程度上凝聚并融合为一个更大的概念，直到今天我们依然能够认出。

sentences.en: Palm trees as a symbol for luxury and leisure.
sentences.zh: 棕榈树作为奢侈和休闲的象征。

sentences.en: So by like 1900, if you went to, say, San Francisco to Union Square,
sentences.zh: 所以在1900年前后，如果你去，比方说旧金山的联合广场，

sentences.en: or if you went to Manhattan or to Paris or to London or any, you know, world city in the West,
sentences.zh: 或者如果你去曼哈顿、巴黎、伦敦，或者西方任何一个世界级城市，

sentences.en: you would find a palm court in the hotel.
sentences.zh: 你会在酒店里发现一个棕榈庭院。

sentences.en: Even the RMS Titanic had a palm court.
sentences.zh: 甚至泰坦尼克号上也设有一个棕榈庭院。

sentences.en: Even though palms were already going international by the dawn of the 20th century,
sentences.zh: 尽管在20世纪初黎明到来之际，棕榈树已经走向国际化，

sentences.en: it was in California, around Los Angeles especially,
sentences.zh: 但正是在加利福尼亚，特别是在洛杉矶周围，

sentences.en: that their place in the global imagination really took root.
sentences.zh: 它们在全球想象中的地位才真正扎下了根。

sentences.en: Oh God.
sentences.zh: 噢天哪。

sentences.en: A trend emerged among homeowners of planting palm trees on either side of their front door.
sentences.zh: 房主中间兴起了一种潮流，在他们前门的两侧种植棕榈树。

sentences.en: At first, this was only a thing that wealthy people did.
sentences.zh: 起初，这只是有钱人做的事情。

sentences.en: But at some point, you're not rich.
sentences.zh: 但不知何时，你其实并不算富有。

sentences.en: You just have a little starter bungalow in L.A.
sentences.zh: 你只是在洛杉矶有一栋小小的入门级平房。

sentences.en: But like you got palm trees too.
sentences.zh: 但你也有棕榈树。

sentences.en: That really did sort of signify you have achieved not just the American dream,
sentences.zh: 这确实象征着你不仅实现了美国梦，

sentences.en: but the California version of the American dream,
sentences.zh: 而且实现了美国梦的加州版本，

sentences.en: which was everything the American dream offered,
sentences.zh: 这就是美国梦所提供的一切，

sentences.en: but also great weather, gorgeous setting,
sentences.zh: 还有棒极了的天气、美不胜收的环境，

sentences.en: trees that flower, smell good, and look good every month of the year.
sentences.zh: 一年四季都能开花、气味芬芳、外观漂亮的树木。

sentences.en: And while this trend is taking off,
sentences.zh: 正当这股潮流腾飞之际，

sentences.en: something happens in the rich suburbs outside of L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶郊外的富裕住宅区发生了一件事。

sentences.en: In towns like Redlands and Riverside, which were then super affluent,
sentences.zh: 在雷德兰兹和里弗赛德等当时超级富裕的城镇，

sentences.en: people there started planting palms not just on private property,
sentences.zh: 那里的人们开始不仅在私人物业上种植棕榈树，

sentences.en: but also along city streets.
sentences.zh: 还在城市街道两旁种植。

sentences.en: Almost as if to say, we will be reminded of luxury everywhere we go.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像是在说，我们无论走到哪里都能想起奢华。

sentences.en: It's about really what I would call the municipal palm,
sentences.zh: 这真正关乎我所说的城市棕榈树，

sentences.en: a palm that symbolizes the city itself and symbolizes good life in the city.
sentences.zh: 一种象征着城市本身并象征着城市美好生活的棕榈树。

sentences.en: Eventually, Los Angeles Proper got hip to this idea of municipal trees.
sentences.zh: 最终，洛杉矶市区也接受了这种城市树木的理念。

sentences.en: And during the Great Depression, the Works Progress Administration
sentences.zh: 在大萧条时期，公共工程署

sentences.en: put a lot of unemployed men to work planting trees throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 安排了许多失业男子在全市各地种植树木。

sentences.en: There are more than 2,500 species of palm tree.
sentences.zh: 棕榈树有2500多个品种。

sentences.en: But as palm trees flourished in California,
sentences.zh: 但随着棕榈树在加利福尼亚繁衍生息，

sentences.en: there's one particular species that stood out.
sentences.zh: 有一个特定的品种脱颖而出。

sentences.en: The Canary Island Date Palm.
sentences.zh: 加那利海枣。

sentences.en: Or Phoenix Canaryensis.
sentences.zh: 或者是加那利海枣（Phoenix canariensis）。

sentences.en: Yeah, that is probably the most spectacular palm in the world, I want to say,
sentences.zh: 是的，就叶子的数量和叶子的宽度而言，我想说这可能是世界上最壮观的棕榈树。

sentences.en: in terms of the number of fronds, the width of the fronds.
sentences.zh: 就叶子的数量和叶子的宽度而言，我想说这可能是世界上最壮观的棕榈树。

sentences.en: And it has a kind of bumpy, cross-hatched trunk from when the fronds detach.
sentences.zh: 当叶子脱落时，它会留下一种凹凸不平、呈交叉阴影的树干。

sentences.en: The Phoenix Canaryensis is so stately and majestic
sentences.zh: 加那利海枣如此庄严宏伟，

sentences.en: that it was used as the symbol of California boosterism at the turn of the century.
sentences.zh: 以至于在世纪之交时被用作加州宣传推广的象征。

sentences.en: One Phoenix was even dug up, put on a rail car,
sentences.zh: 甚至有一棵加那利海枣被挖出来，装上铁路货车，

sentences.en: and freighted all the way to Chicago for the 1893 Columbian Exposition.
sentences.zh: 一路货运到芝麻加参加1893年的哥伦布世界博览会。

sentences.en: And every day on the trunk, California boosters would put up a piece of paper
sentences.zh: 加州的宣传人员每天都会在树干上贴一张纸，

sentences.en: that listed the temperature at Coronado Beach in San Diego and at Lake Michigan,
sentences.zh: 上面列出圣迭戈科罗纳多海滩和密歇根湖的温度，

sentences.en: just for comparison.
sentences.zh: 纯粹是为了作比较。

sentences.en: Us Californians have always been dicks about our weather.
sentences.zh: 我们加州人总是喜欢拿我们的天气来显摆。

sentences.en: After the exposition, the palm tree was sent back to California.
sentences.zh: 博览会结束后，这棵棕榈树被送回了加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: Obviously, it wasn't going to be left to suffer in the frigid city of Chicago.
sentences.zh: 显然，它不可能被留在寒冷的芝麻加城受罪。

sentences.en: Can you imagine?
sentences.zh: 你能想象吗？

sentences.en: The horror.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: This is me being a dick about our weather.
sentences.zh: 这是我在拿我们的天气显摆。

sentences.en: For a long time, the Phoenix Canaryensis was mostly a symbol of Southern California.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，加那利海枣主要南加州的象征。

sentences.en: But eventually, especially by the 1990s,
sentences.zh: 但最终，特别是到了20世纪90年代，

sentences.en: they were also in hot demand up north in the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 湾区北部对它们的需求也变得非常迫切。

sentences.en: And since the Phoenix Canaryensis takes 50 to 60 years to mature,
sentences.zh: 由于加那利海枣需要50到60年才能成熟，

sentences.en: tree nurseries couldn't keep up with the demand.
sentences.zh: 苗圃根本无法满足需求。

sentences.en: You just can't manufacture more 50-year-old palm trees.
sentences.zh: 你总不能凭空造出更多50年树龄的棕榈树来。

sentences.en: So there are people called palm brokers.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种人叫棕榈树经纪人。

sentences.en: They go to older residential neighborhoods where people have like a little bungalow.
sentences.zh: 他们去一些老住宅区，那里的人们住着那种小平方的平房。

sentences.en: They're like the third generation in that bungalow.
sentences.zh: 他们往往是那个平房里的第三代居民。

sentences.en: They now have this, you know, 80-foot palm tree.
sentences.zh: 他们现在拥有了一棵，你知道的，80英尺高的棕榈树。

sentences.en: They might have some sentimental attachment to it,
sentences.zh: 他们可能对它有些情感上的依恋，

sentences.en: but it's actually not doing much for them.
sentences.zh: 但实际上它对他们并没有多大用处。

sentences.en: And someone offers them a few hundred dollars for it,
sentences.zh: 当有人出价几百美元买下它时，

sentences.en: and they'll take it off their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们就会顺水推舟把它卖掉。

sentences.en: And many people take that opportunity, especially in a time of recession.
sentences.zh: 很多人都抓住了这个机会，特别是在经济衰退时期。

sentences.en: The Canary Island date palm craze has died down a little,
sentences.zh: 加那利海枣的热潮虽然已经消退了一些，

sentences.en: but they're still in high demand.
sentences.zh: 但它们的需求量仍然很大。

sentences.en: And between the demand, the time it takes for a tree to mature,
sentences.zh: 由于市场需求、树木长成所需的时间，

sentences.en: and the sheer heft of moving these things,
sentences.zh: 以及搬运这些庞然大物的巨大分量，

sentences.en: the Phoenix Canaryensis is the most expensive palm tree to buy.
sentences.zh: 加那利海枣成了购买成本最高昂的棕榈树。

sentences.en: The going price, including a truck to move it,
sentences.zh: 市面上的价格，包括运送它的卡车，

sentences.en: a crane to lift it, and a crew to plant it.
sentences.zh: 起吊的起重机，以及种植的施工队。

sentences.en: It's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 这是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: 20 grand a tree?
sentences.zh: 一棵树两万美元？

sentences.en: Yes, again, $20,000 a tree.
sentences.zh: 没错，再说一遍，一棵树20,000美元。

sentences.en: And that is why, to bring us back to our earlier story,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，回到我们之前的故事，

sentences.en: Angelino Brent Green was so outraged
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶人布伦特·格林会如此愤怒，

sentences.en: when he saw that work crew in his neighborhood that summer night in 2011.
sentences.zh: 当他在2011年那个夏夜看到社区里的施工队时。

sentences.en: They were there, Brent believes, to steal more than $100,000 worth of palm trees.
sentences.zh: 布伦特相信，他们是去偷价值超过10万美元的棕榈树的。

sentences.en: Brent reported what he saw to the police,
sentences.zh: 布伦特向警方报告了他所看到的情况，

sentences.en: also got the local NBC affiliate on the trail.
sentences.zh: 还让当地的全国广播公司分支机构介入了调查。

sentences.en: And our investigation has found this could be an inside job.
sentences.zh: 我们的调查发现这可能是一起内部作案。

sentences.en: We've found at least one Caltrans official could be involved in these thefts.
sentences.zh: 我们发现至少有一名加州交通局的官员可能牵涉到这些盗窃案中。

sentences.en: Long story short, an employee at the California Department of Transportation
sentences.zh: 长话短说，加州交通局的一名员工

sentences.en: had signed off on a work order allowing a third party to go in and remove the trees.
sentences.zh: 签署了一份工作订单，允许第三方进入并移除这些树木。

sentences.en: A lawsuit followed, one result of which was six Canary Island date palms
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是一场诉讼，其结果之一就是六棵加那利海枣

sentences.en: getting put back on the freeway berm in Brent's neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 被重新种回了布伦特社区的高速公路路堤上。

sentences.en: At any rate, it might not matter too much in the grand scheme of things
sentences.zh: 无论如何，从宏观角度来看这可能并没有那么重要，

sentences.en: because the treescape of Los Angeles is about to have a lot fewer palm trees to steal.
sentences.zh: 因为洛杉矶的树木景观里很快就没有那么多棕榈树可偷了。

sentences.en: A fungus called Fusarium wilt has been rampantly killing off certain species of palm trees,
sentences.zh: 一种名为镰刀菌枯萎病的真菌一直在疯狂杀死某些种类的棕榈树，

sentences.en: including the Phoenix canariensis.
sentences.zh: 包括加那利海枣。

sentences.en: In fact, several different landscape designers told me
sentences.zh: 事实上，几位不同的景观设计师告诉我，

sentences.en: that they avoid using the Phoenix canariensis palms right now
sentences.zh: 他们现在避免使用加那利海枣，

sentences.en: because of their susceptibility to the wilt.
sentences.zh: 因为它们极易感染枯萎病。

sentences.en: And on top of that, as of 2006,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，截至2006年，

sentences.en: the city of Los Angeles has greatly curbed its replanting of fan palMs.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶市已经大幅限制了扇葵的重新种植。

sentences.en: Those are the really tall, spindly guys with the skinny trunks.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些有着细长树干、极高且枝叶稀疏的家伙。

sentences.en: A motion approved by the city council stated that
sentences.zh: 市议会批准的一项动议指出，

sentences.en: fan palms don't provide adequate tree cover,
sentences.zh: 扇葵无法提供足够的树冠遮阴，

sentences.en: they don't release enough oxygen into the atmosphere,
sentences.zh: 它们向大气中释放的氧气不够多，

sentences.en: and they shed so many fronds that they are considered hazardous.
sentences.zh: 而且它们掉落的叶fronds太多，因此被认为是危险的。

sentences.en: All the palm trees that got planted in the teens, 20s, and 30s
sentences.zh: 所有在1910年代、20年代和30年代种植的棕榈树

sentences.en: are all going to be dying of old age in the next few decades.
sentences.zh: 在未来几十年内都将因年迈而枯死。

sentences.en: And without them getting replanted,
sentences.zh: 如果不重新种植，

sentences.en: palms will largely disappear from the Los Angeles streetscape.
sentences.zh: 棕榈树将在很大程度上从洛杉矶的街景中消失。

sentences.en: Though, of course, palm trees will still get replanted
sentences.zh: 当然，棕榈树仍会被重新种植

sentences.en: in the iconic spots where people expect palm trees to be.
sentences.zh: 在那些人们期望看到棕榈树的标志性地点。

sentences.en: Designated tourist zones like Hollywood and Sunset Boulevards
sentences.zh: 像好莱坞大道和日落大道这样的指定旅游区，

sentences.en: where they will always be because tourists expect them to be there
sentences.zh: 它们将永远在那里，因为游客期望它们在那里，

sentences.en: because that is what L.A.
sentences.zh: 因为那是洛杉矶

sentences.en: is supposed to look like.
sentences.zh: 应有的样子。

sentences.en: But Jared Farmer is actually not too sad
sentences.zh: 但贾里德·法默其实并不怎么难过

sentences.en: to see the palms of Southern California go.
sentences.zh: 看到南加州的棕榈树消失。

sentences.en: Mind you, this is a guy who writes about trees for a living
sentences.zh: 请记住，这家伙以写树木为生，

sentences.en: and is a self-proclaimed lover of palMs.
sentences.zh: 并且自称是棕榈树的爱好者。

sentences.en: In a time of less water, more people,
sentences.zh: 在水资源减少、人口增多的时代，

sentences.en: I think we have to make wiser choices
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须做出更明智的选择，

sentences.en: about the kind of trees we use.
sentences.zh: 关于我们所使用的树木种类。

sentences.en: And California will still have an incredibly diverse treescape.
sentences.zh: 加州仍将拥有极其丰富的树木景观。

sentences.en: But a Los Angeles without palm trees?
sentences.zh: 但是没有棕榈树的洛杉矶？

sentences.en: Not on Brent Green's watch, anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正只要布伦特·格林在，这就不会发生。

sentences.en: He told me that when he was a kid,
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，当他还是个孩子的时候，

sentences.en: he used to draw houses with palm trees next to them.
sentences.zh: 他经常画旁边长着棕榈树的房子。

sentences.en: And now that he's a grown-up,
sentences.zh: 而现在他长大了，

sentences.en: he's fulfilled his own Californian-American dream.
sentences.zh: 他实现了自己的加利福尼亚美国梦。

sentences.en: Though his house is a modest bungalow,
sentences.zh: 虽然他的房子是一栋简朴的平房，

sentences.en: it's made so much more stately
sentences.zh: 但由于他家门前大约10棵棕榈树的点缀，

sentences.en: by the 10 or so palms in front of his home.
sentences.zh: 它显得庄严宏伟了许多。

sentences.en: And even knowing everything I know about palms,
sentences.zh: 即使我知道关于棕榈树的一切，

sentences.en: that they were basically marketing tools
sentences.zh: 知道它们基本上只是营销工具，

sentences.en: and how they play to this phony sense of exoticism,
sentences.zh: 以及它们如何迎合这种虚假的异国情调，

sentences.en: I have to say, it all still kind of works on me.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认，这一切对我还是挺有用的。

sentences.en: I found myself in awe
sentences.zh: 我发现自己对布伦特对加州梦充满了敬畏

sentences.en: and a little jealous of Brent's California dream.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有点嫉妒。

sentences.en: And I've got my own palm trees now.
sentences.zh: 我现在也有自己的棕榈树了。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm very proud of it.
sentences.zh: 我为此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: I love my palMs.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的棕榈树。
